verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no role-based access control for restricting investigation or administrative actions. The only related control is an adjacent one: the case assignee is the only person who can add an approver, and only if the workflow allows peer approvals. That ties a permission to case assignment, not to configurable roles. Workflow configuration and organization settings are not described as role permissions.

support.subject: As a operations-lead, I can restrict investigation and administrative actions to appropriate roles

citations.quote: You must be the assignee of the case in order to add an approver, and the workflow must be configured to allow for peer approvals.
